build.testCommand:
mkdir -p /Users/nyimbiodero/src/pjs/apg/.github/workflows

cat > /Users/nyimbiodero/src/pjs/apg/.github/workflows/ci.yml << 'EOF'
# APG Capability Library — Continuous Integration
#
# Runs on every push and pull request to main.
# Gates: contract validation, integration tests, composability tests, build check.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.12"

jobs:
  # ── 1. Contract Validation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  contracts:
    name: Contract Validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install "pydantic>=2.0" "uuid6>=0.4" "sqlalchemy>=2.0" flask

      - name: Validate all 259 capability contracts
        run: |
          python -c "
          import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
          from capabilities.capability_contract_registry import validate_contract_registry
          r = validate_contract_registry()
          print(f'Contracts: {r[\"contract_count\"]}  Errors: {r[\"error_count\"]}')
          assert r['valid'], f'Contract errors: {r[\"errors\"][:5]}'
          assert r['contract_count'] == 259, f'Expected 259 contracts, got {r[\"contract_count\"]}'
          print('All 259 contracts valid')
          "

      - name: Verify all requires are satisfied
        run: |
          python -c "
          import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
          from capabilities.capability_contract_registry import load_contract_registry
          registry = load_contract_registry()
          all_ids = set(registry.keys())
          violations = [f'{cap} requires unknown: {req}'
              for cap, rec in registry.items()
              for req in rec.contract.get('requires', [])
              if req not in all_ids]
          assert not violations, violations
          print(f'All requires satisfied across {len(registry)} capabilities')
          "

      - name: Check streaming events coverage
        run: |
          python -c "
          import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
          manifest = json.loads(open('capabilities/MANIFEST.json').read())
          caps = list(manifest['capabilities'].values())
          no_events = [c['id'] for c in caps if not c.get('streaming_events')]
          assert not no_events, f'Missing streaming events: {no_events}'
          print(f'All {len(caps)} capabilities have streaming events')
          "

  # ── 2. Quality Gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  quality:
    name: Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install "pydantic>=2.0" "uuid6>=0.4" flask

      - name: Check all capabilities are world-class (40+ methods)
        run: |
          python -c "
          import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
          manifest = json.loads(open('capabilities/MANIFEST.json').read())
          caps = list(manifest['capabilities'].values())
          below = [(c['id'], c['service_method_count']) for c in caps if c['service_method_count'] < 40]
          assert not below, f'Below world-class threshold: {below[:5]}'
          methods = [c['service_method_count'] for c in caps]
          import statistics
          print(f'All {len(caps)} capabilities world-class (40+ methods)')
          print(f'Mean: {statistics.mean(methods):.1f}  Min: {min(methods)}  Max: {max(methods)}')
          "

  # ── 3. Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tests:
    name: Test Suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pytest pytest-asyncio
          pip install "pydantic>=2.0" "uuid6>=0.4" "sqlalchemy>=2.0" flask fastapi httpx

      - name: Run composability tests
        run: python -m pytest tests/test_composability_comprehensive.py -q --tb=short

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest \
            tests/test_integration_finance.py \
            tests/test_integration_fintech.py \
            tests/test_integration_intelligence.py \
            tests/test_integration_platform.py \
            -q --tb=short

      - name: Run core compiler tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest \
            tests/test_parser.py \
            tests/test_semantic_analyzer.py \
            tests/test_capability_contract_public_api.py \
            tests/test_system_integration_simple.py \
            -q --tb=short

  # ── 4. Build Verification (sample) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  build:
    name: Package Build Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install build tools
        run: pip install build setuptools>=68 wheel

      - name: Build sample of key capability packages
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/apg-wheels
          for cap in \
            capabilities/intel/alerts \
            capabilities/fin/arc/accounts_receivable \
            capabilities/fintech/payments \
            capabilities/hcm/pay/payroll \
            capabilities/common/auth \
            capabilities/government/tax \
            capabilities/healthcare/emr; do
            echo "Building $cap..."
            python -m build --wheel --quiet --outdir /tmp/apg-wheels/ "$cap"
          done
          echo "Wheels built: $(ls /tmp/apg-wheels/*.whl | wc -l)"

      - name: Verify wheels install and expose entry points
        run: |
          pip install /tmp/apg-wheels/apg_intel_alerts*.whl
          python -c "
          from apg_intel_alerts import get_capability_contract
          c = get_capability_contract('ci_test')
          assert c['capability'] == 'intel_alerts'
          assert c['ui']['requires_theme'] == True
          print('Wheel install and entry point: OK')
          "

  # ── 5. APG Compiler (example programs) ─────────────────────────────────────
  compiler:
    name: APG Compiler
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install antlr4 and compiler deps
        run: pip install "antlr4-python3-runtime==4.13.2" "pydantic>=2.0" flask

      - name: Compile all 6 platform example programs
        run: |
          python -c "
          import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
          from compiler.compiler import APGCompiler
          c = APGCompiler()
          examples = [
            'examples/crm_platform/main.apg',
            'examples/accounting_platform/main.apg',
            'examples/erp_platform/main.apg',
            'examples/intelligence_platform/main.apg',
            'examples/fintech_platform/main.apg',
            'examples/healthcare_platform/main.apg',
          ]
          all_ok = True
          for ex in examples:
            r = c.compile_file(ex, output_dir=f'/tmp/apg_{ex.split(\"/\")[-2]}')
            status = 'OK' if r.success else f'FAIL: {r.errors[0].message[:50] if r.errors else \"?\"}'
            print(f'  {ex.split(\"/\")[-2]}: {status}')
            if not r.success: all_ok = False
          assert all_ok, 'Some examples failed to compile'
          "
EOF
echo "Written .github/workflows/ci.yml"
